# Facto

> Facto is a verified directory and ranking of SaaS startups, with public MRR and revenue information, country and category discovery, and comparison pages for founders, buyers and investors.

Use individual SaaS profiles to review each product and find related alternatives. Revenue and MRR are only shown when a founder has connected a supported payment provider.

## Main pages

- [Facto home](https://www.factosaas.com/): Entry point to the verified SaaS ranking and startup directory.
- [SaaS directory](https://www.factosaas.com/saas): Browse SaaS startups by revenue, category and recency.
- [SaaS by category](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria): Explore software categories and their listed alternatives.
- [SaaS by country](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/pais): Explore the SaaS ecosystem and rankings by country.

## Categories

- [AI tools](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria/ai): AI software, automation and model-powered SaaS alternatives.
- [CRM tools](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria/crm): Customer relationship management software and alternatives.
- [Marketing tools](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria/marketing): Marketing, acquisition and growth software alternatives.
- [Management tools](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria/gestion): Business management and operations software alternatives.
- [Sales tools](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria/ventas): Sales software, ordering and commercial workflow alternatives.
- [Restaurant tools](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/categoria/restaurantes): Restaurant operations and digital menu software alternatives.

## Countries

- [SaaS in Colombia](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/pais/colombia): Software and SaaS startups based in Colombia.
- [SaaS in México](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/pais/mexico): Software and SaaS startups based in México.
- [SaaS in Perú](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/pais/peru): Software and SaaS startups based in Perú.
- [SaaS in Chile](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/pais/chile): Software and SaaS startups based in Chile.
- [SaaS in Argentina](https://www.factosaas.com/saas/pais/argentina): Software and SaaS startups based in Argentina.
